description: Access To Electricity By Planning Region, Annual is a dataset listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Singapore Department of Statistics. Source: ENERGY MARKET AUTHORITY Data Last Updated: 16/01/2026 Update Frequency: Annual Footnotes: Data refer to electricity access on mainland Singapore. Planning regions in Singapore, namely Central, West, North, North-East and East Regions, are based on Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) Master Plan 2019 (www. ura. gov. sg/Corporate/Planning/Master-Plan/Master-Plan-2019). Data are used for SDG 7. 1. Coverage: Singapore. The portal files it under the publisher Singapore Department of Statistics. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
